versions.changelog: 修复节点 ID 写死问题

Initial release of feishu-img-tool – a CLI utility for uploading and sending images to Feishu chats.

- Supports uploading images to Feishu and retrieving an image_key.
- Allows sending images to users or chats by uploading or using existing image_key.
- CLI usage: send images via `node feishu-image-tool.js send --target <open_id> --file <path>`.
- Configurable via environment variables or config file; requires Feishu app credentials.
- Enforces size, format, and resolution limits per Feishu API.
- Requires permissions: im:message and im:image.
